title: Assistant Manager - Product Delivery
description:
Assistant Manager – Product Delivery
   

  

 Location: Mumbai
   

  

 At IDfy, a great product only creates value when it actually lands \- deployed, adopted, and working in the real world. As our Assistant Manager – Product Delivery, you'll be the person who makes that happen: turning client requirements into working solutions, translating messy real\-world problems into clean product outcomes, and owning delivery end\-to\-end from the first conversation to go\-live. If you love figuring out "what the client actually needs, how to solve it, and how to ship it" \- this role is built for you.
   

  

**We're The Perfect Match If You**
* Have 1–3 years of experience in a client\-facing implementation, SaaS delivery, solutioning, or technical project role.
* Have worked directly with enterprise clients and juggled multiple stakeholders and workstreams without dropping the ball.
* Are AI\-first and hands\-on \- you reach for AI tools instinctively to move faster and solve smarter.
* Bring a can\-do attitude \- when someone says "this is tricky," your first instinct is "let's figure it out."
* Communicate with clarity and influence \- equally comfortable aligning a client's HR team and rallying internal Product \& Engineering.
* Thrive on ownership and ambiguity \- you'd rather run a thread yourself than wait for a map.


**Here's What Your Day Would Look Like**
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of IDfy's products for clients \- from requirement understanding through solutioning, UAT, and go\-live \- within agreed timelines.
* Get deep into the client's employee onboarding journey and HRTech ecosystem to spot process and product gaps before they become delivery issues.
* Translate client requirements into clear, actionable asks for internal teams \- and translate the most appropriate solution back out to the client.
* Partner across teams to balance what the client wants against what's buildable, scalable, and on\-time.
* Act as the key point of contact across the delivery lifecycle, keeping clients and internal Product / Engineering / Sales / CX aligned.
* Run multiple client implementations at once \- tracking dependencies, risks, blockers, and timelines, and prioritizing by client impact and business criticality.
* Spot recurring patterns and push to standardize and improve how delivery gets done.


 Why IDfy
   

  

 At IDfy, we don't just build products \- we build trust infrastructure for the digital economy. In this role, you'll sit at the frontline of how that trust actually reaches clients: owning delivery, shaping solutions, and working shoulder\-to\-shoulder with Product and Engineering.
   

  

 If you've ever wanted to turn delivery puzzles into product wins \- this is your playground.

title: Manager - SAP
description:
**Job Description**
 We are searching for an experienced and skilled SAP Project Manager to join our SAP PM Competency \- Delivery department. In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing and managing end\-to\-end SAP projects, including implementation, rollout, migration, and support. Your expertise will be crucial in ensuring these projects are delivered successfully, meeting the defined scope, budget, and timelines. As a key member of our team, you will play a vital role in driving our SAP initiatives forward and contributing to the overall success of Bristlecone India Limited.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead and manage end\-to\-end SAP implementation, rollout, migration, and support projects.
* Develop comprehensive project plans, including scope, timeline, and resource allocation.
* Execute projects efficiently, ensuring adherence to defined processes and methodologies.
* Manage and coordinate cross\-functional teams, fostering effective collaboration.
* Conduct regular project reviews and progress assessments, identifying and mitigating risks.
* Maintain open and transparent communication with stakeholders, keeping them informed of project status.
* Ensure timely and accurate documentation of project activities and deliverables.
* Provide effective problem\-solving and decision\-making during project execution.
* Conduct post\-project reviews and implement lessons learned for continuous improvement.
* Stay updated with the latest SAP technologies and industry best practices.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* A minimum of 8 years of experience in SAP project management, with a proven track record of successful project delivery.
* In\-depth knowledge of SAP PM Competency and its applications.
* Strong project management skills, including the ability to plan, execute, and monitor projects.
* Excellent leadership and team management abilities, with a collaborative approach.
* Proficiency in SAP project management tools and methodologies.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
* Analytical thinking and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Willingness to stay updated with emerging SAP technologies and trends.


**About Us**
**ABOUT US**
 Bristlecone is the leading provider of AI\-powered application transformation services for the connected supply chain. We empower our customers with speed, visibility, automation, and resiliency – to thrive on change.
   

  

 Our transformative solutions in Digital Logistics, Cognitive Manufacturing, Autonomous Planning, Smart Procurement and Digitalization are positioned around key industry pillars and delivered through a comprehensive portfolio of services spanning digital strategy, design and build, and implementation across a range of technology platforms.
   

  

 Bristlecone is ranked among the top ten leaders in supply chain services by Gartner. We are headquartered in San Jose, California, with locations across North America, Europe and Asia, and over 2,500 consultants. Bristlecone is part of the $19\.4 billion Mahindra Group.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 Bristlecone is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status .
   

  

**Information Security Responsibilities**
* Understand and adhere to Information Security policies, guidelines and procedure, practice them for protection of organizational data and Information System.
* Take part in information security training and act while handling information.
* Report all suspected security and policy breach to InfoSec team or appropriate authority (CISO).
* Understand and adhere to the additional information security responsibilities as part of the assigned job role.

title: Manager - Ecommerce transformation
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Consulting \- Manager \- Ecommerce Transformation**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 The Manager \- Ecommerce Transformation will drive ecommerce transformation initiatives within the Customer practice, combining digital commerce strategy, customer experience improvement, operating model design, and delivery excellence. The role will support clients in improving online growth, commerce operations, product discovery, conversion, order experience, and omnichannel effectiveness. You will work with business and technology stakeholders to shape commerce roadmaps, design scalable operating models, and implement transformation initiatives that improve revenue realization, digital adoption, customer experience, and operational efficiency.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Business Development \& Market Leadership
+ Support ecommerce transformation pipeline development across advisory, implementation, and managed transformation opportunities.
+ Contribute to proposals, RFP responses, business cases, demos, and executive presentations focused on digital commerce growth and operational improvement.
+ Support GTM strategies for ecommerce transformation offerings across B2B, B2C, and marketplace\-led business models.
+ Design and refine commerce transformation offerings aligned with client priorities, including digital channel growth, product data improvement, checkout optimization, and omnichannel enablement.
+ Contribute to thought leadership, client workshops, and points of view on ecommerce trends, digital buying behaviour, platform modernization, and commerce operating model evolution.


* Client Engagement \& Delivery
+ Lead ecommerce transformation workstreams from current\-state assessment through strategy, roadmap design, implementation planning, and execution support.
+ Assess commerce journeys, digital storefronts, product information flows, merchandising processes, search and navigation, order management touchpoints, and performance metrics to identify improvement opportunities.
+ Design ecommerce operating models, governance structures, product data processes, merchandising workflows, channel strategies, and performance management frameworks.
+ Support initiatives across product discovery, catalog readiness, personalization, pricing and promotions, cart and checkout, order visibility, returns experience, and customer support integration.
+ Partner with product, technology, data, marketing, sales, and operations teams to translate commerce priorities into structured requirements, process flows, user stories, and delivery roadmaps.
+ Develop business cases and benefits models to quantify conversion improvement, revenue uplift, digital adoption, cost\-to\-serve reduction, and operational productivity gains.
+ Ensure delivery excellence across assigned workstreams, including scope, timeline, budget, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder alignment.
+ Support change management, adoption, and governance activities to embed sustainable commerce capabilities across business teams.


* Technology \& Innovation
+ Enable teams to leverage ecommerce platforms, product information management systems, order management systems, CRM, analytics, personalization tools, automation, and AI\-enabled insights.
+ Stay ahead of technology trends shaping ecommerce transformation, including composable commerce, headless architecture, AI\-enabled product discovery, personalization, digital shelf analytics, and omnichannel orchestration.
+ Identify opportunities to develop reusable accelerators for commerce journey assessment, product data maturity, conversion diagnostics, and benefits tracking.


* Leadership \& People Development
+ Manage project teams or workstreams and ensure high\-quality delivery across ecommerce transformation engagements.
+ Mentor consultants and analysts on ecommerce strategy, requirements structuring, delivery governance, and cross\-functional stakeholder management.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Demonstrate knowledge of digital commerce capabilities, including B2B and B2C commerce, marketplace models, dealer and distributor portals, and subscription commerce.
* Have exposure to leading commerce platforms and ecosystems, including Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce, Shopify, SAP Commerce Cloud, commerce tools, BigCommerce, Akeneo, Salsify, and similar technologies.


**What We Look For**
* 8\+ years of experience in ecommerce transformation, digital commerce, omnichannel strategy, customer experience, product data transformation, or commerce operations.
* Consulting experience is desired.
* Proven experience supporting or leading ecommerce transformation programs, digital channel improvement initiatives, or commerce operating model redesign.
* Strong understanding of ecommerce journeys, digital merchandising, product information management, order experience, conversion optimization, and commerce performance metrics.
* Hands\-on experience with ecommerce platforms, analytics tools, PIM, OMS, CRM, or related digital commerce technologies.
* Strong business development support, stakeholder management, communication, and project delivery skills.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

 Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Product Intern - US Stocks
description:
Title : Product Intern
   

  

 Location : Mumbai
   

  

 Work arrangement: 5 days in the office
   

  

**About Upstox**
 At Upstox, we’re building the future of investing simple, powerful, and for everyone. We’re one of India’s fastest\-growing fintech platforms, backed by the best in the business, including Mr. Ratan Tata and Tiger Global, and on a mission to make wealth creation accessible to every Indian. From first\-time investors to seasoned traders, millions trust us to power their financial journeys. We’re not just moving fast, we're moving with purpose. If you thrive in a high\-energy, high\-impact environment, you’re in the right place.
   

  

 The Role: Product Intern – US Stocks
   

  

 You’ll join the US Stocks Product team and help build and scale products that enable Indian investors to invest in the US stock market.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on, 0\-to\-1 product role where you’ll work across product discovery, research, competitive intelligence, partner evaluation, and integrations. You’ll work closely with design, engineering, growth, and external partners to turn ideas into products that customers can use. You won’t inherit a finished playbook, you'll help build it.
   

  

 What You’ll Own
   

  

* Write and refine PRDs and help drive features from idea to launch — scoping requirements, chasing open questions, and keeping execution on track.
* Run competitive intelligence across Indian and global US\-stock investing platforms. Track what competitors are building, break down their features, and identify opportunities relevant to our roadmap.
* Research the US Stocks investing ecosystem and understand customer needs, market trends, product offerings, and the overall investing journey.
* Identify and evaluate vendors and partners required for the product, including market data, trading infrastructure, payments, compliance\-related services, and other third\-party solutions.
* Drive integrations end to end, coordinating with external partners and internal teams to get third\-party services live and working smoothly.
* Work closely with Design, Engineering, Growth, and other stakeholders to translate product requirements into execution.
* Roll up your sleeves on the groundwork: research, analysis, documentation, partner coordination, testing, and the unglamorous wiring that turns an early idea into a real product.


 What We’re Looking For
   

  

* Very hands\-on with AI. You use AI daily to research, prototype, analyze, draft, and move faster — and you’re constantly figuring out new ways to use it.
* Strong ownership. You take a problem and run with it end to end, without needing constant hand\-holding.
* A figure\-it\-out instinct. When you don’t know something, you find the answer yourself instead of waiting to be told.
* Sharp product sense and genuine curiosity about investing, financial products, and how users interact with them.
* Interest in US Stocks and global investing is a strong plus.
* Strong written communication. You can take a messy problem and turn it into a clear, structured document.
* High comfort with ambiguity and a strong bias for action.


 Why This Role Rocks
   

  

 You’ll be part of a fast\-moving US Stocks Product team, building products that open up global investing opportunities for Indian investors.
   

  

 You’ll get hands\-on exposure to 0\-to\-1 product building, global investing, fintech partnerships, integrations, competitive intelligence, and product execution — while owning real problems and seeing your work go live.
   

  

 By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have reviewed our Prospective Employee Privacy Notice, which outlines how Upstox collects, uses, and protects your Personal Information ("PI").

description:
****Job Summary****
 Synechron is seeking a
 **Java Developer** 
 with at least
 **7 years of Java development experience** 
 and proven experience leading a team of Java developers. The role is responsible for developing, maintaining, and delivering scalable Java\-based applications and systems for large enterprise environments. This position will translate business requirements into technical solutions, support high\-quality software delivery, resolve technical issues, and contribute to innovation through modern development practices, microservices architecture, and cloud computing.
   

  

****Required****
**Software Requirements (Required and Preferred)**
* Java: At least 7 years of professional experience developing Java\-based applications and systems.
* Java Development Tools: Experience using standard Java development, testing, debugging, build, and deployment tools.
* Software Development Methodologies: Practical experience with Agile, Scrum, or comparable iterative delivery methodologies.
* Application Development: Experience designing, developing, testing, deploying, maintaining, and supporting enterprise Java applications.
* Version Control and Collaboration Tools: Experience using organization\-approved source control, issue tracking, code review, and collaboration tools.
* Testing Tools: Experience developing and executing unit, integration, and functional tests for Java applications.
* Enterprise Delivery Practices: Experience delivering Java\-based solutions within a large enterprise environment.


****Preferred****
* Java SE 11 or later: Experience developing applications using Java 11 or a later supported version.
* Microservices Technologies: Experience designing and developing microservices\-based applications.
* Cloud Computing Platforms: Practical exposure to cloud\-based application development, deployment, or support.
* Java Frameworks: Experience with commonly used Java application frameworks and libraries relevant to enterprise development.
* Deployment and Automation Tools: Exposure to continuous integration, continuous delivery, containerization, or deployment automation tools.
* Java Development Certification: Advanced certification aligned with Java development, such as a Java SE 11 Developer certification.


****Overall Responsibilities****
* Lead, coordinate, and mentor a team of Java developers while supporting effective collaboration, technical growth, and high\-quality delivery.
* Develop, enhance, maintain, test, and deploy Java\-based applications and systems that meet defined business and technical requirements.
* Design and implement scalable, efficient, maintainable, and supportable Java solutions for large enterprise environments.
* Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical designs, development tasks, implementation plans, and measurable delivery outcomes.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to resolve technical issues, manage dependencies, and support informed engineering decisions.
* Apply software development methodologies, coding standards, testing practices, and documentation requirements throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Troubleshoot application defects, performance issues, integration challenges, and production incidents within agreed timelines.
* Contribute to the adoption of microservices architecture, cloud computing, and other relevant technologies where they support business and operational objectives.
* Review technical designs, code, test results, and implementation plans to identify risks and improve solution quality.
* Promote maintainable solutions that use resources efficiently, reduce avoidable processing, and consider sustainability in application design and cloud usage where applicable.
* Track delivery progress, communicate risks and dependencies, and support continuous improvement across the development team.


****Technical Skills (By Category)****
**Programming Languages**
****Essential****
* At least 7 years of professional experience with Java programming.
* Strong understanding of object\-oriented programming, exception handling, collections, concurrency, and application design principles.
* Experience developing, debugging, testing, and maintaining Java\-based enterprise applications.


****Preferred****
* Experience with Java 11 or later.
* Experience with scripting or additional programming languages used to support automation, integration, or application operations.


**Databases and Data Management**
****Essential****
* Experience integrating Java applications with relational or enterprise data stores.
* Ability to work with application data models, queries, transactions, data validation, and persistence requirements.
* Experience troubleshooting application issues involving data access, consistency, or performance.


****Preferred****
* Experience with both relational and non\-relational databases.
* Familiarity with database performance optimization, indexing, transaction management, and data migration.


**Cloud Technologies**
****Essential****
* Understanding of cloud computing concepts relevant to application development, deployment, scalability, and support.
* Ability to contribute to Java application delivery in cloud\-based or hybrid environments.


****Preferred****
* Hands\-on experience deploying or supporting Java applications on cloud platforms.
* Experience with cloud\-native development, containerized applications, scalable services, monitoring, and resource optimization.


**Frameworks and Libraries**
****Essential****
* Experience using Java frameworks and libraries to develop maintainable enterprise applications.
* Understanding of application layers, service components, dependency management, configuration, and integration patterns.
* Experience designing or supporting scalable application components.


****Preferred****
* Experience developing microservices\-based applications.
* Exposure to frameworks and libraries used for web applications, REST services, dependency injection, persistence, messaging, or distributed systems.
* Experience applying design patterns and principles that improve application maintainability and reuse.


**Development Tools and Methodologies**
****Essential****
* Experience with Agile, Scrum, or comparable software development methodologies.
* Experience with source control, code reviews, defect tracking, build management, testing, deployment, and technical documentation.
* Experience participating in requirements analysis, technical design, development, testing, release, and post\-production support.
* Experience leading or coordinating development activities within a team.


****Preferred****
* Experience with continuous integration and continuous delivery practices.
* Exposure to automated build, deployment, quality analysis, monitoring, and containerization tools.
* Experience working with iterative planning, estimation, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and continuous improvement activities.


**Security Protocols**
****Essential****
* Understanding of secure software development practices for Java applications.
* Ability to apply appropriate authentication, authorization, input validation, secure error handling, and protection of sensitive data.
* Awareness of secure API communication, access controls, vulnerability management, and organizational security standards.


****Preferred****
* Experience implementing security controls in microservices or cloud\-based applications.
* Exposure to secure coding assessments, application security testing, encryption practices, and security reviews.


****Experience Requirements****
* At least 7 years of professional experience in Java development.
* Proven experience leading, mentoring, or coordinating a team of Java developers.
* Demonstrated experience developing and delivering Java\-based applications and systems in a large enterprise environment.
* Experience translating business requirements into technical solutions and guiding implementation through development, testing, deployment, and support.
* Experience with Agile, Scrum, or comparable software development methodologies.
* Experience with microservices architecture and cloud computing is preferred.
* Experience resolving technical issues, supporting production applications, and meeting delivery timelines.
* Industry or domain experience relevant to the assigned business environment is preferred but not required unless specified for a particular project.
* Candidates may qualify through equivalent professional experience demonstrating comparable Java development expertise, technical leadership, enterprise delivery, and successful implementation outcomes.


**Day\-to\-Day Activities**
* Lead and mentor a team of Java developers, assign or coordinate development activities, review technical work, and support delivery quality.
* Analyze business requirements, participate in design and planning discussions, and translate requirements into Java\-based technical solutions.
* Develop, test, deploy, maintain, and troubleshoot Java applications while monitoring delivery progress, risks, dependencies, and technical issues.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to implement new technologies, make decisions within approved technical standards, and deliver maintainable solutions within agreed timelines.


****Qualifications****
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered.
* At least 7 years of professional experience in Java development, including experience delivering enterprise Java applications and systems.
* Proven experience leading or mentoring Java developers and coordinating technical delivery activities.
* Advanced Java development certification, such as a Java SE 11 Developer certification, is preferred.
* Commitment to continuous professional development through relevant training, technology learning, certification opportunities, and evolving software engineering practices.


**Professional Competencies**
* Apply critical thinking and structured problem\-solving to assess requirements, identify root causes, evaluate trade\-offs, and implement effective technical solutions.
* Provide technical leadership through mentoring, constructive feedback, work coordination, knowledge sharing, and support for team delivery.
* Communicate technical information, delivery progress, risks, decisions, and issues clearly with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Adapt to changing requirements, technologies, delivery priorities, and enterprise constraints while maintaining solution quality.
* Identify practical opportunities to improve application design, development efficiency, automation, scalability, maintainability, and responsible use of technology resources.
* Manage time and priorities across team leadership, requirements analysis, development, testing, issue resolution, stakeholder collaboration, and delivery commitments.
